real_through_routes: POST /api/acca/sit {action:'start'} → attempt created by the route
POST /api/acca/case/turn ×3 (sitting:true) → the one sit write path
POST /api/acca/sit {action:'finish'} → what the client fires on the expired-while-away arm
GET  /api/acca/sit ×2 → the real served payload the decision runs on
method.single_synthetic_step: the attempt's started_at/ends_at were moved 4h back with the service client. The route computes ends_at from now and cannot be asked for a deadline already passed, so a genuinely expired attempt cannot be produced any other way. The ROW is route-created; only the two timestamps moved.
method.paper: APM paper-1, 7 requirements across 3 cases; 3 answered, 4 never reached

the_finding.shape: completed=true AND 3 of 7 submitted — a paper that ended on the clock with an unreached tail
the_finding.computed_on: the REAL GET /api/acca/sit payload, not a literal
the_finding.note: the old `else` also emitted mock_intro_viewed for this shape — an intro view recorded for a student who was never shown the intro

server_accepted_it.why_zero_weakness_rows: the walk's answers were one-line placeholders, so every answered requirement banded 'nothing' — the deliberate no-write band (lib/acca/weak-areas.ts). Expected, and the same reason the ledger holds 0 rows globally; not a property of this fix.
server_accepted_it.why_it_matters: 'done' is not a cosmetic redirect — the paper the old arms hid behind the Start screen marks cleanly, and the unreached tail is reported as not_reached rather than blank.
